gdpGrowthRates.description: Real GDP per-capita growth rates per decade (%, from Maddison Project). Useful for calibrating Economy sector growth baseline.

USA.note: Wartime production boom + post-war consumer boom

DEU.note: War destruction, then Wirtschaftswunder recovery from 1948

RUS.note: Massive war destruction, then post-war rebuild

JPN.note: War destruction, then US occupation recovery from 1945

CHN.note: PRC established, land reform, then Great Leap Forward disruption

USA.note: Vietnam War spending, Great Society programs

CHN.note: Great Leap Forward famine + Cultural Revolution disruption

notes: These figures are annualized per-capita real GDP growth rates (not nominal, not total GDP).
The simulation currently uses total GDP growth — a simple multiplier on the total GDP value.
For calibration: apply these rates as expected deltas from the 1939 baseline over the 30-tick run.
If simulation GDP moves in the right direction but at wrong magnitude, adjust the growth handler's sensitivity parameter.
The war-casualty effect on GDP (negative for attacked nations, potentially net-positive for some economies) is a separate calibration concern.
